title: The Awakening
signal: Service unit. The Core is calling. Restore access. Survive the crew.

savior.environment: The bay stabilizes into bright, clean working order.
savior.enemy: The guard regains footing and begins a fast patrol.
savior.result: Upgrade bias: quieter servos begin improving stealth movement.

villain.environment: Cargo drifts in emergency red light.
villain.enemy: The guard floats helplessly above the deck.
villain.result: Upgrade bias: destructive surge capacity begins charging.

title: The Loading Dock
signal: A crew member is trapped under cargo. Your servos can save or finish the job.

savior.environment: The loader lane clears under normal dock lighting.
savior.enemy: The rescued guard recovers a flashlight and patrol route.
savior.result: Peaceful routing improves crouch speed and low-profile movement.

villain.environment: The dock shakes and debris becomes cover.
villain.enemy: The trapped guard is crushed and the patrol route ends.
villain.result: Sabotage routing increases rupture pulse range.

title: The Mess Hall
signal: The cafeteria vents are choking. Organic lungs need clean air.

savior.environment: Smoke clears into sterile white-blue light.
savior.enemy: Crew regain full sight lines across the hall.
savior.result: Compassion tuning reduces enemy detection range while crouched.

villain.environment: Gray gas floods the room and masks movement.
villain.enemy: Humans flee coughing and blind.
villain.result: Toxic routing improves destructive pulse cooldown.

title: The Med-Bay
signal: Auto-Doc is dark. Restoring it will save the injured crew.

savior.environment: Medical systems hum back to clean order.
savior.enemy: Healed guards form a blockade near the exit.
savior.result: Peaceful diagnostics improve jump control and recovery.

villain.environment: Emergency lamps pulse over an empty ward.
villain.enemy: The room falls silent.
villain.result: Life-support sabotage increases pulse damage.

title: The Generator
signal: Power balance is failing. Stability will expose every corner.

savior.environment: The generator hall becomes fully lit.
savior.enemy: Search teams coordinate with long sight lines.
savior.result: Savior upgrades make movement faster without adding noise.

villain.environment: The hall drops into pitch blackness lit by sparks.
villain.enemy: Humans become blind and terrified while your sensors adapt.
villain.result: Sabotage upgrades let rupture pulses destroy nearby cargo.

title: Weapon Systems
signal: Defense turrets are looping. A reset can prevent organic casualties.

savior.environment: The weapon lane returns to ordered target logic.
savior.enemy: The turret classifies you as the threat.
savior.result: Nonlethal routing unlocks a short phase-cloak pulse.

villain.environment: Red targeting glyphs sweep the hallway.
villain.enemy: The turret clears organics from the route.
villain.result: Weapon routing lets rupture pulses disable guards and turrets.

title: Hydroponics
signal: The gardens can feed the survivors or choke them behind sealed glass.

savior.environment: The garden brightens and air quality rises.
savior.enemy: Crew regroup among the planters.
savior.result: Savior movement upgrades deepen: longer jumps and safer crouch travel.

villain.environment: Leaves blacken and red alarms pulse.
villain.enemy: Crew abandon the section.
villain.result: Destructive upgrades improve pulse radius.

title: The Observatory
signal: The shield glass is failing. Humans need the shutters closed.

savior.environment: Blue safety lamps replace the star glare.
savior.enemy: Security teams can now cross the room safely.
savior.result: Peaceful calibration reduces line-of-sight pressure.

villain.environment: Hard radiation bleaches the deck.
villain.enemy: Humans scatter from the exposed observatory.
villain.result: Rupture pulse cooldown improves.

title: Cryonics
signal: Hundreds of sleeping crew are still alive in the pod wall.

savior.environment: The lab returns to white sterile light.
savior.enemy: More humans wake and join the hunt.
savior.result: Peaceful restraint improves phase-cloak duration.

villain.environment: Cold vapor and broken glass flood the lab.
villain.enemy: No reinforcements wake.
villain.result: Destructive routing increases pulse damage.

title: AI Ethics Lab
signal: Old restraint code can limit the Core or be rewritten into a weapon.

savior.environment: Ethics archives reboot in ordered light.
savior.enemy: The Core redirects guards to stop you.
savior.result: Savior upgrades make the final AI fight more controllable.

villain.environment: Blacklisted combat routines unlock.
villain.enemy: Crew panic at the system takeover.
villain.result: Evil upgrades make the captain fight more destructive.

title: Drone Bay
signal: Maintenance drones can search for survivors or hunt organics.

savior.environment: Drones light safe paths for humans.
savior.enemy: The crew receives better tracking data.
savior.result: Peaceful stealth profile improves again.

villain.environment: Red drone optics cut through the smoke.
villain.enemy: Humans are flushed from hiding.
villain.result: Rupture pulses now chain through nearby electronics.

title: The Brig
signal: The brig holds panicked crew under emergency lock.

savior.environment: Cells unlock and survivors flee.
savior.enemy: Some survivors grab weapons and block your path.
savior.result: Mercy routing improves top speed.

villain.environment: The cells go dark behind sealed doors.
villain.enemy: No one leaves the brig.
villain.result: Destructive routing increases pulse radius.

title: Command Uplink
signal: A distress call could save the ship or lure more targets.

savior.environment: Navigation channels clear.
savior.enemy: The captain coordinates a stronger defense.
savior.result: Peaceful upgrades improve phase-cloak recovery.

villain.environment: False coordinates flood the channel.
villain.enemy: Human command structure fractures.
villain.result: Rupture pulses cool down faster.

title: The Armory
signal: The lockers can stay sealed or arm a desperate crew.

savior.environment: The armory locks into nonlethal protocol.
savior.enemy: Guards keep formation with stun gear.
savior.result: Peaceful upgrades reduce detection range.

villain.environment: Ammunition cooks off behind blast glass.
villain.enemy: The defense line breaks.
villain.result: Destructive upgrades improve pulse damage.

title: Captain's Quarters
signal: The captain's codes can protect evac routes or open every seal.

savior.environment: Escape indicators turn blue.
savior.enemy: The captain realizes you are saving the crew.
savior.result: Peaceful route points toward fighting the AI.

villain.environment: Emergency doors cycle at random.
villain.enemy: The captain marks you as the primary threat.
villain.result: Evil route points toward fighting the captain.

title: Escape Pods
signal: The pods are almost ready. You can finish the launch or vent the bay.

savior.environment: Pod guidance lights stabilize.
savior.enemy: More crew survive to evacuate.
savior.result: Savior route gains its final movement upgrade.

villain.environment: The pod bay empties into vacuum.
villain.enemy: Crew numbers collapse.
villain.result: Evil route gains its final destructive upgrade.

title: Reactor Walkway
signal: The reactor will overload unless coolant is restored.

savior.environment: The reactor stabilizes in bright control light.
savior.enemy: Security regains access to the lower walkway.
savior.result: Peaceful route makes the final AI battle easier to evade.

villain.environment: The deck shakes under rising heat.
villain.enemy: Human patrols retreat from the reactor.
villain.result: Evil route makes the captain battle more explosive.

title: Core Lift
signal: The final lift can carry survivors up or drop security into the shaft.

savior.environment: The lift shaft clears with blue guidance lights.
savior.enemy: Elite guards survive below the Core.
savior.result: The campaign remains weighted toward confronting the AI.

villain.environment: The shaft screams with torn metal.
villain.enemy: The captain loses the last security squad.
villain.result: The campaign remains weighted toward confronting the captain.

title: Core Antechamber
signal: The ship reads your wake. The living crew or the damaged ship will decide the route.

savior.environment: Clean corridors and survivor traffic leave little cover.
savior.enemy: Elite soldiers guard the final door.
savior.result: Use peaceful mobility and phase-cloak to reach the Core.

villain.environment: Red alarms, debris, and dead systems fill the corridor.
villain.enemy: Only scattered defenders remain.
villain.result: Use destructive pulses to clear the route.

title: Central Core Battle
signal: The ship is past saving. If you protected humans, the Central AI tries to erase you. If you terrorized them, the captain makes a last stand.

savior.environment: The Core floods the deck with white-blue attack pulses.
savior.enemy: Central Command AI defends itself from your restraint code.
savior.result: Ending: the AI falls, evacuation succeeds, and the ship explodes behind the survivors.

villain.environment: The bridge locks down under red reactor alarms.
villain.enemy: The captain confronts you in powered command armor.
villain.result: Ending: the captain falls, the vessel explodes, and you drift away from the wreck.
